faq.title: You might be wondering.
faq.intro: Photos, the first 24 hours, credits: here are the answers, with links if you’d like more detail.

availability.question: When and where will Histae be available?
availability.answer: Histae is being tested on Android by invited testers only. There is no announced date for a public launch yet. Open the listing with the Google account associated with your invitation. The link alone does not grant access to the test. No iOS test or App Store link has been announced yet. This page will be updated when access opens.

account.question: How do I create an account?
account.answer: Start with your profile, preferences and consent choices. Your phone number and SMS verification come last. Registration is for adults and currently supports French +33 numbers. Returning users go straight to phone verification.

discovery.question: How are suggested profiles selected?
discovery.answer: Histae checks both people’s preferences: age, who you are looking for and maximum distance must work for each of you. Compatible profiles are shown in order of proximity. Blocks in either direction, saved likes or passes, and people you already have a recorded match with are excluded.

match.question: How does a match work?
match.answer: After mutual likes, you can talk for 24 hours. Sending then pauses for another 24 hours, while history remains readable. The chat button lets you choose to continue and confirm any cost. A notification can tell you the other person would like to continue; only both agreements reopen the conversation. A decline or the deadline passing without both agreements ends the match.

photos.question: Do I need to add a photo, and who can see it?
photos.answer: A photo is required for the feed but stays hidden from suggested profiles. Take one with the camera or choose from your gallery. Both people must agree before sharing in a match, separately from continuation. Either person can withdraw consent and hide both photos again. Replacing a photo also updates it in matches where sharing is allowed.

pricing.question: What is the difference between Free and Premium?
pricing.answer: You can create a profile, match and start chatting for free. Free includes {freeCredits} weekly credits to continue conversations, up to {weeklyMaximum} extensions. An optional video earns one credit, with up to {advertisingStock} ad credits in reserve until Monday at 00:00 UTC. Premium removes the quota and advertising. Current prices are on the Pricing page and confirmed before payment. After 10 days without a new message, a confirmed conversation is archived. A warning is sent after 23 days; the match and messages are deleted after 30 days. A new message resets the deadline without spending another credit.

location.question: How is location used and retained?
location.answer: Location is used only for discovery with separate consent, and the displayed distance is rounded. It becomes stale after one hour, is deleted after 24 hours without an update and disappears immediately when consent is withdrawn.

moderation.question: Can I block or report someone?
moderation.answer: Yes, in the app. Blocking someone ends your matches and prevents another one while the block is active. You can also report them and explain what happened.

privacy.question: How can I exercise my rights or delete my data?
privacy.answer: Privacy and safety lets you export your data, delete your account, manage consent and revoke sessions. My requests is for corrections you cannot make yourself: describe the data and follow the reply. The website footer also links to data and account deletion tools.

sourceCode.question: Can I read the code and carry out a security audit?
sourceCode.answer: Original Histae code is public for inspection and security audits. Reuse, including non-commercial reuse, redistribution and use in another project are prohibited without prior written permission. This is not an open-source license. Third-party components retain their own licenses. External contributions are not accepted.

emptyFeed.question: Why is my feed empty?
emptyFeed.answer: Check your profile, photo, preferences and consent choices, and make sure pause mode is off. Your location and the other person’s must both be less than an hour old. People you have already liked, passed, blocked or matched with are also excluded. You can update your location or adjust your preferences if you wish; an empty feed may simply mean that no profiles meet these conditions at the moment.

ranking.question: Are profiles rated or ranked by popularity?
ranking.answer: No. Histae does not assign attractiveness ratings or popularity scores, and does not use an Elo system. Profiles that meet both people’s preferences are shown in order of proximity. Receiving more likes does not move a profile up the feed.

pause.question: Can I take a break without losing my matches?
pause.answer: Yes. Pause mode, available in your profile, removes you from new suggestions and stops discovery of new profiles. Your existing matches and conversations remain available. When you resume, the usual requirements apply, including a recent location.

reading.question: How do I read and move between profiles?
reading.answer: The bar at the top fills during three seconds of reading. You can then double-tap to like or swipe up at the end of the text to pass; buttons offer the same actions. Aa adjusts text size and line spacing. The first-feed guide remains available in Help and contact.

drafts.question: Are unsent messages kept?
drafts.answer: Yes. Message drafts and answers to profile questions are kept on this device so you can find them after closing the app. They do not sync between devices and are erased on sign-out. This does not include your biography.

conversations.question: How do I find a match or spot unread messages?
conversations.answer: Search by first name in Your matches. Each match’s counter shows unread messages. Archived conversations have a separate entry point. Tapping a name in a conversation opens the profile, including the photo if both people have agreed to share.

notifications.question: When does the app send a notification?
notifications.answer: With your permission, background alerts can cover matches, messages, a request to continue, mutual confirmation or shared photos. Reminders also accompany deadlines. A reply to a data request or a new sign-in can trigger an alert too. Match alerts show the first name, without message contents. The open app updates without these system alerts; manage devices and notifications from your profile.

renewal.question: When do credits renew, and what if I run out?
renewal.answer: Weekly balances reset on Monday at 00:00 UTC. Your credits shows the next deadline in local time. Without free credits, a video can add one when limits allow. After the weekly continuation cap is reached, the app suggests subscriptions instead of a video. If no ad is available, it tells you; no credit is added.

help.question: Where can I get help or contact Histae?
help.answer: Open Help and contact in Profile to revisit the feed guide, read explanations about photos, credits and purchases, or contact support. The contact address also appears in every website footer.
